parsed.rationale: All three records are `type-alias-object` declarations in the `Wallpaper` package with empty `fields_or_signature` lists. The structural signal of `shared_field_count: 2` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` indicates the pipeline matched them on shape alone (both are zero-field type aliases), not on any shared semantic content. `PlaybackButtonControls`, `ThemeDebugOverlay`, and `WallpaperView` are clearly distinct domain concepts — playback UI controls, a debug overlay, and a wallpaper view — whose structural coincidence is purely an artifact of each being a typealias wrapper with no stored fields. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated abstractions and provide no reduction in duplication.
